name: legal-gemma  ·  HaqSetu
blurb: Legal navigation for Indian citizens that never leaves your machine. Hybrid retrieval over a 2,981-span statute corpus, IPC to BNS mapping, multimodal Gemma 4. No cloud, no API key.

name: RF-Gemma
blurb: Camera-free body sensing from WiFi CSI, reasoned over by Gemma 4: physics it can cite, alerts it can justify. Real MM-Fi data, live 3D replay dashboard.

name: 100csv
blurb: Ranks 100 candidates out of 100,000 offline on CPU in under five minutes. BM25 + dense retrieval fused by RRF, cross-encoder rerank, Isolation Forest integrity gate. No LLM in the decision.

name: hamming-twin
blurb: A digital twin of Richard Hamming. Answers in his voice, grounded in his own papers and talks, and remembers what you tell it within and across conversations.

name: EcoAudit
blurb: Audit-grade ESG evidence on mobile. Append-only audit log, SHA-256 on every blob, server-side geofenced proof of presence, row-level security by institution.

name: dtu-nsut-insider
blurb: Everything they don't tell you about DTU & NSUT: JAC counselling, branch predictor, placements, insider opportunities and real student experiences. Trusted by 25K+ students.
